subject: Request: Log TTL exemption + coordinated backup decommission plan
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Sara Bloom <sara.bloom@medlink.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Log TTL exemption + coordinated backup decommission plan

Hi Sara —

Thanks again for taking the call yesterday. Per MedLink's upcoming audit window, you flagged a requirement to keep a subset of application logs for 18 months, which conflicts with our standard 90‑day rolling TTL for ephemeral logs and the planned backup decommission on July 3.

To move forward we propose a short-lived, scoped exception and a coordinated plan for the backup purge so that your evidence and export needs are satisfied while minimizing our retention footprint. High level proposal (attached as an editable schedule):

- Scope: app-logs (service: api-gateway + auth) only; exclude debug traces and integrations.
- TTL exception window: extend to 18 months for scoped logs only; automatic revert 2029-01-01 unless renewed.
- Backup purge: snapshot-based purge on 2028-07-03 across long-term archives; create a 30‑day escrow copy for MedLink export (S3 presigned bundle).
- Evidence package: log retention exception form (attached), sample export manifest, and MD5 checksums.

Can you confirm MedLink is comfortable with the scoped approach and the 30‑day escrow bundle? If so, we'll route the exception form through Security for sign-off and schedule the DocuSign.

Next steps I suggest:
1) Sara confirm scope + escrow window (reply)
2) Kimberly to fill the technical runbook and escalation points
3) Laura to coordinate procurement & DocuSign for the exception fee

Thanks — hoping to close the loop by EOD Monday.

--
Michael Grant
Head of Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192
From: Sara Bloom <sara.bloom@medlink.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@medlink.com
Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 11:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Request: Log TTL exemption + coordinated backup decommission plan

Michael —

Thanks, that summary is helpful. MedLink can accept a scoped exception for the API gateway and auth logs only — we do need the 18‑month retention for incident reconstruction requirements. A few clarifying points:

- The 30‑day escrow bundle is acceptable, but we need encrypted export and Proof of Possession (hash manifest) at creation time.
- Who will be the technical contact at Redwood for retrieval requests after the purge? We need a named contact for audit purposes.
- Cost: procurement is looped for any fees associated with the exception and escrow storage.

If you can provide the filled exception form and a runbook that lists the retrieval SLA (e.g., 5 business days) and contact, we'll initiate the internal approval.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Regards,
Sara Bloom
Director, IT Compliance
MedLink Health
sara.bloom@medlink.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sara Bloom <sara.bloom@medlink.com>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 16 Jun 2028 08:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Log TTL exemption + coordinated backup decommission plan

Sara —

On Fri, Jun 15, 2028 at 11:05 AM Sara Bloom <sara.bloom@medlink.com> wrote:
> Michael —
>
> Thanks, that summary is helpful. MedLink can accept a scoped exception for the API gateway and auth logs only — we do need the 18‑month retention for incident reconstruction requirements.
>
> The 30‑day escrow bundle is acceptable, but we need encrypted export and Proof of Possession (hash manifest) at creation time.

Thanks for the confirmation. Quick technical notes and runbook excerpt follows. Full runbook is included as rowed sheets in the attached backup-retention-schedule.xlsx.

- Export/escrow process:
  1) At T-7 days before purge, snapshot relevant log partitions and run an integrity check (SHA256).
  2) Copy snapshots to a customer-specific S3 escrow bucket (server-side AES256); generate a signed manifest.json with hashes and receipt timestamp.
  3) Notify MedLink with presigned download link valid for 30 days; retain copy for 30 days then delete unless retrieval initiated.

- Retrieval SLA: 5 business days from time of request (standard); can be expedited to 48 hours with documented justification (fee applies).
- Technical contact for retrievals: Karthik Iyer (karthik.iyer@redwood.com) and backup ops oncall (ops+backup@redwood.com).
- Rollback/rollback test: We will run a restore dry-run in our staging environment 3 days prior to the purge and share logs proving restore integrity.

Edge cases: cross‑region logging shards (EU) — these are out of scope for this exception unless MedLink confirms cross-border consent.

I'll attach the runbook rows and the prefilled log-retention-exception-form.pdf for signatures.

--
Karthik Iyer
Lead SRE, Persistence & Backup
Redwood Inference
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Sara Bloom <sara.bloom@medlink.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Jun 2028 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Log TTL exemption + coordinated backup decommission plan

Sara / team —

Great — thank you for the quick confirmation. To confirm next actions and owners: 

- Karthik: finalize the runbook and post the restore dry‑run report to the drive link; include SHA256 manifest in the package.
- Kimberly: route the prefilled exception form through Security for sign-off and coordinate DocuSign.
- Laura: coordinate procurement for the escrow storage fee and route the quote to procurement@medlink.com (cc'd).
- Michael: I will be the executive contact for the exception and will approve the final DocuSign envelope once Security has signed off.

Target timeline:
- 2028-06-20: Security sign-off + DocuSign envelope ready
- 2028-06-28: Dry‑run restore complete and report posted
- 2028-07-03: Backup purge + escrow bundle created and 30‑day retrieval window opens

If any party needs a different cadence, flag it today so we can adjust. I'll upload the final exception form to the HubSpot record and share the DocuSign link once ready.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this out cleanly.

Best,
Michael Grant
Head of Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
